name: Eritrea

flag.description: A red triangle based on the hoist stretches to the fly, dividing a green upper triangle from a blue lower one; a gold olive branch inside a gold olive wreath stands upright in the hoist part of the red triangle.
flag.symbolism: Green stands for agriculture, blue for the Red Sea and red for the blood shed in the fight for independence; the olive branch and wreath stand for peace.

hook: Eritrea's red triangle reaches all the way to the fly, splitting green land from the blue Red Sea, with a gold olive wreath at the hoist.
trivia: Eritrea became independent from Ethiopia in 1993, confirmed by a referendum after a 30-year war.
Its capital Asmara was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2017 for its early 20th-century modernist architecture.
